answer: Let trust propagate through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, with voting weight discounted by the walk’s probability of reaching independently anchored nodes. For any Sybil set \(S\), low conductance \(\phi(S)=|\partial S|/\mathrm{vol}(S)\) means few transitions escape its cluster, limiting transitive support from honest attestations. Thus, even if nebula, crystal, and mesa are densely linked internally, sparse external cuts bound their aggregate voting weight rather than letting identity count alone amplify influence.
